The spatula is lifted away from the meat pan and moved across the hob.
The same spatula stirs the scrambled egg in the small dark pan beside it.

supported_claims.text: Two pans are on the hob together: a large pan with round pink breakfast-meat pieces and a small pan with egg.
The breakfast-meat pieces are turned and pushed with the spatula first.
The spatula then moves to stir the egg in the other pan.
